title: Selection pressure cannot create candidates; fixes for generation problems live in generative levers
rule: A scorer-metric reweight only reorders the candidate population that already exists; it cannot create a better board. When the population lacks any board that satisfies the goal, the fix MUST be a generative lever (placement / routing / waypoint intent / keepout / pour), never a scorer penalty. The in-loop auditor may price a metric ONLY when a gate-passing candidate already exists and pricing is needed to rank it first.
rationale: SENSEC2 validation run (2026-06-11): the auditor proposed scorer reweights (max_T w15 -> kelvin_unrouted w500 -> back to max_T) every round; the actuation-space verifier refuted all of them and 0 rules landed, because no candidate ever had intact pours for a reweight to select. The framework's own rationale for FR-02 / generative levers, validated empirically.
notes: Process/charter rule (retrospective §6 candidate 2). Advisory-only (kind heuristic, never compiles to a gate). FINAL HOME pending Decision 16 (process-corpus custody); staged here for owner sign.

title: A panel verdict with any dark seat is a QUORUM verdict and must say so
rule: A multi-seat verifier panel returns a FULL verdict only when every seat votes substantively (support/refute). If any seat is dark -- errored, budget-exhausted, suspended, or a non-substantive 'uncertain' (e.g. spec-conformance on an empty corpus) -- the verdict type is QUORUM and must carry the live/dark seat roster with each dark seat's reason. A dark seat is an abstention, never a silent concurrence; downstream treats a QUORUM verdict as lower-confidence than a FULL one.
rationale: SENSEC2 validation run: all 4 rounds reported final=refute flat while spec-conformance was dark (empty promoted/ corpus) every round and round 2 also timed out -- 2-of-3 quorums mislabeled as full verdicts. Implemented as VerifierResult.verdict_type/live_seats/dark_seats (cec_verifier.py).
notes: Process/verifier-policy rule (retrospective §6 candidate 5). Advisory-only. FINAL HOME pending Decision 16; staged for owner sign.

title: The citable-fact set and the verifier's evidence-bundle set are one contract
rule: The set of fact classes the auditor may cite and the set of facts placed in the verifier's evidence bundle are ONE contract and must not drift. A zero-tolerance provenance check is sound only while bundle == citable set; once they diverge it refutes TRUE facts (worse than no check). Both sets must project from one authoritative fact registry, each fact carrying its source-stage provenance, so 'not in bundle' is distinguishable from 'not in the canonical fact set' and only the latter is hallucination. Widening the bundle ad hoc re-drifts on the next new fact class.
rationale: SENSEC2 validation run: the evidence-provenance seat refuted the auditor's TRUE pour-integrity facts (islands, foreign_cross, copper) and FEM flags because the verifier bundle carried only DRC/unconnected/kelvin_ok. Contract check added as bundle_gaps() (cec_fullstack.py); the bundle now carries the pour/FEM facts the auditor sees.
notes: Process/schema rule (retrospective §6 candidate 6). Advisory-only. FINAL HOME pending Decision 16; staged for owner sign.

title: Panel behavior is analyzed from seat reasoning, never inferred from verdict codes
rule: When analyzing a verification panel's behavior, read the seats' actual reasoning text, never infer it from verdict codes alone. A 'refute' code does not tell you WHICH owned-lever objection or provenance gap drove it; inferring it produces wrong conclusions.
rationale: SENSEC2 retrospective: the implementing agent's first deep-dive claimed GR-02 corridor-clear was the surviving lever; reading the actuation-space seat's primary output showed it refuted GR-02 ITSELF (foreign-crossing control is owned by FR-02 waypoint intents/placement, not GR-02), and the analysis was corrected against the seat record. The correction discipline (claim -> primary-source refutation -> recorded fix) is the worked example.
notes: Process-corpus rule (retrospective §6 candidate 7). Advisory-only, prose. FINAL HOME pending Decision 16; staged for owner sign.

title: Signal routing never crosses a Kelvin sense pour corridor
rule: A signal trace must never be routed through a /SENSEC*_HI|LO sense pour corridor: it fragments the pour (islands>1), reduces sense-copper cross-section, and strands the Kelvin connection. Enforced on TWO horizons: at GENERATION the sense corridors are bake_hints keepouts + FR-02 waypoint intents that route the OFFENDING foreign nets around them; at VERIFICATION a BLOCKING pour-integrity gate requires islands==1 per sense net. kelvin_ok checks connectivity only and is blind to fragmentation.
rationale: SENSEC2 run: every round drove signal through the cable-2 corridor, fragmenting SENSEC2_HI 1->3 islands (-21% copper) while kelvin_ok stayed true. Now in code: cec_score.pour_integrity_ok (gate), cec_fr02.offending_net_intents (generation). Round-4 board is the AM-02 fixture (fires the gate); round-1 passes.
notes: Retrospective §6 candidate 1. Code-backed (gate + generation lever exist); golden dry-run CLEAN. Advisory in staging; owner sign promotes the gate to blocking-in-promoted.

title: No proxy metric earns scorer credit while a blocking gate fails
rule: While gates_pass is false, no proxy metric (e.g. DRC count) may earn ranking credit: a gate-failing board's cost is a fixed base plus the pour-integrity term ONLY, so the loop cannot buy proxy improvement by destroying the physical objective. Copper-area reward is gate-failing-only so it cannot reorder two passing boards.
rationale: SENSEC2 run: the scorer credited DRC (28->5) while gates never passed, riding the proxy into a -21% sense-copper board. In code: cec_score.objective_v2 (gate-gated DRC, gate-fail-only copper reward).
notes: Retrospective §6 candidate 3. Code-backed (objective_v2). Advisory in staging; FINAL HOME pending Decision 16.

title: A scorer-metric reweight already refuted this run is auto-rejected (lever-class change forced)
rule: When the auditor re-proposes a scorer-metric reweight whose metric was already refuted this run (cycling or rising weight, gates still failing), a deterministic tripwire auto-rejects it with NO verifier spend and forces a lever-class change. Same metric, refuted, re-proposed = wrong knob, bigger hammer.
rationale: SENSEC2 run: the auditor thrashed max_T(w15)->kelvin_unrouted(w500)->max_T, refuted every round. In code: cec_fullstack.inject() knob tripwire on lr['refuted_metrics'] + the pre-verify skip.
notes: Retrospective §6 candidate 4. Code-backed (deterministic tripwire). Advisory in staging; FINAL HOME pending Decision 16.
